name: eduiy16
noteEs: Uno de los creators de Warframe en español más establecidos, Warframe Creator/Partner oficial desde hace años. Su canal se enfoca en builds de warframes y armas, guías de eventos y farmeo, tips y cobertura de updates — efectivamente el hub hispano de 'cómo armo/farmeo X'. De larga trayectoria y actividad constante, es la referencia obvia para players hispanohablantes que quieren guías prácticas.
noteEn: One of the most established Spanish-language Warframe creators, an official Warframe Creator/Partner for years. His channel focuses on warframe and weapon builds, event and farming guides, tips and update coverage — effectively the Spanish-language hub for 'how do I build/farm X'. Long-running and consistently active, he's the obvious reference for Spanish-speaking players who want practical guides.
highlightsEs: Guías de builds de warframes y armas en español
Guías de eventos y farmeo eficiente
Cobertura de updates y tips para la comunidad hispana
Larga trayectoria como Partner oficial de Warframe
highlightsEn: Warframe and weapon build guides in Spanish
Update coverage and tips for the Spanish-speaking community
Long tenure as an official Warframe Partner
